name: 14569 · Warsaw, NY
findings: ZIP 14569 (Warsaw) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14569 (Warsaw) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14569 (Warsaw) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
